lead: A key figure in a card, the tile of a dashboard or a report. `title`, `value`, `prefix` / `suffix`, `color` and `loading` are those of [Statistic](/statistic); `variant` and `radius` are the card's.

grid.title: In a grid
grid.description: A [Grid](/grid) with `minColumnWidth` lays the tiles out and wraps them on a narrow screen.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: StatisticCard is Card + Statistic and has no slot of its own.
